text:
rachel: noticed a small uptick in funcall parse errors after int4 canary for nightingale-lite. Delta: 0.35% -> 1.6% on short payloads (<180 chars).

ivan: can you share a minimal example?

rachel: pasted: 
```
int4: {"op":"tag","args":{"label":"it\u2019s urgent"}}
parser: Error: invalid escape sequence at 12

fp16: {"op":"tag","args":{"label":"it's urgent"}}
```

sara: pattern matches other threads: smart-apostrophe and some doubled backslashes appearing in strings. Might be a quantization-induced tokenization hop.

ml-canary-bot: Alert: nightingale-lite int4 structured_parse_fail_rate = 1.6% (baseline 0.35%).

ivan: immediate plan: 1) add a lightweight pre-parse sanitizer that normalizes curly quotes and collapses duplicate escapes; 2) run an int4 recompile with gentler logits floor and token bias; 3) add targeted golden cases for contractions and diacritics.

rachel: I can prototype sanitizer. Will instrument telemetry with labels "raw_parse_fail", "repaired_by_sanitizer" and keep repaired counts separate from gating.

sara: good — do not hide raw failures in alerts. Also schedule an A/B where we prepend system prompt hint: "Prefer ASCII punctuation and do not emit smart quotes." Mark traces with "ascii-hint-v1".

ivan: started canary job nightingale-int4-bias-171901-1. ETA 12m.

ml-canary-bot: Update: nightingale-int4-bias-171901-1 finished. Raw parse_fail_rate = 1.5%. Post-sanitizer parse_fail_rate = 0.48%. Sanitizer recovered 68% of failures.

rachel: decent stopgap. We'll ship sanitizer behind a feature flag for Hosted for 48 hours, with auto-disable if repaired_by_sanitizer falls below 40% or if raw failures spike further.

sara: also add token-level logging on the failed samples to pinpoint which subtokens flip under int4. Ivan, can you spin that up?

ivan: will do. Adding three contrived golden tests now (names: O'Neill, Zoë, emoji-only).

rachel: thanks — will open PR for sanitizer (small patch) and link tests.

ml-canary-bot: Note: please remember to keep fallback to fp16 as a last resort for adaptive-fallback experiments; cost ops aware.

sara: ack. We'll keep fallback rate-capped and telemetry visible. :ok_hand:
